study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using normative models pre-trained on cross-sectional data to evaluate intra-individual longitudinal changes in neuroimaging data

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilises the 'Early Stages of Schizophrenia' dataset and a pre-trained normative model (lifespan_58K_82_sites) trained on 58,836 participants.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: To illustrate our approach, we applied it to a longitudinal dataset of 98 patients diagnosed with early-stage schizophrenia... The clinical data used for the analysis were part of the Early Stages of Schizophrenia study... The pre-trained model used for adaptation was the lifespan_58K_82_sites
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/RehakBuckova2025.pdf.md: Abstract; Methods / Data / Early stages of schizophrenia patients; Methods / Preprocessing and Analysis

answer.Early Stages of Schizophrenia: clinical validation (patients) and model adaptation/noise estimation (controls)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The Early Stages of Schizophrenia dataset was used to validate the method on patients and adapt the model using controls. The pre-trained model provided the cross-sectional normative reference.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: To illustrate our approach, we applied it to a longitudinal dataset of 98 patients... We used the data of 33 healthy controls which were originally used for the site-specific adaptation... We exploit the existing normative models pre-trained on over 58,000 individuals
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/RehakBuckova2025.pdf.md: Abstract; Discussion / Methodological contribution; Methods / Preprocessing and Analysis

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The pre-trained model was fit on 58,836 participants. For local adaptation, the study analysed 67 controls, with 33 explicitly mentioned for site-specific adaptation/z-diff score computation.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: The original models were fit on a large dataset consisting of 58,836 participants... We analysed data from 98 patients... and 67 controls... We used the data of 33 healthy controls which were originally used for the site-specific adaptation
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: study_1/RehakBuckova2025.pdf.md: Methods / Model formulation / Original model for cross-sectional data; Methods / Data / Early stages of schizophrenia patients; Discussion / Methodological contribution

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics for the pre-trained model are not reported. For local controls, the median age is 29 years (range 18-54).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex statistics for the pre-trained model are not reported. For local controls, 42 out of 67 are female (63%), so 25 are male (37%).
